outcome: Neonatal death within 24 hours after birth
cohort: 627 live births with gestational age of 23-31 weeks, birth weight of 500-1499g without malformations, born in 19 public maternity hospitals in nine capitals in northeastern Brazil.
finding: The high neonatal mortality on the first day of life in capital cities of Northeast Brazil is associated with biological variables such as weight and gender of the newborn, low vitality at birth, and worse hospital infrastructure.
